notes.title: General Game Update
notes.content: [p]Based on user feedback, we have given the game a bit of an overhaul:[/p][p][/p][p][b]General changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased clarity for when you get a Game Over via extra effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some collision settings that will make it easier to get a bubble into a gap.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notification for when bubbles are flying in and added a display to make it clearer as to why it's happening:[/p][list][*][p]Each 5 bubbles you launch triggers a few bubbles to fly in.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a timer that will occasionally launch in an additional bubble.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bubbles you connect outside of the boundary that would normally trigger a Game Over will now burst if there is 3 of the same color connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments to boost performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Two new powerups[/b][/p][list][*][p]Freeze - While active, stops the bubble grid from spinning when bubbles hit it.[/p][/*][*][p]Scope - Adds a screen/scope to your launcher to assist with aiming the next shot.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]In general, this should make the game clearer and a bit easier. Thanks for playing![/p]
